templates.title: Night out
templates.summary: The first pour, the room, cheers with friends, and an invite with the name and the happy hour.

steps.title: The pour
steps.position: At the bar, elbows on the bar top
steps.direction: Rest your elbows on the bar and hold the phone still beside the glass while the bartender pulls a pint or strains a cocktail.

captions.script: First round of the night, poured right in front of us.
Fresh off the tap, poured right in front of me.
Watch this pour. The bartender makes it look easy.

steps.title: Where we are
steps.position: At the bar, glass in hand
steps.direction: Switch to the front camera, hold the glass up beside your face and say where you are tonight.
steps.prompter: Night out, first drink, and this is where we started.

captions.script: Night out, first drink, and this is where we started.
Best way to start a night out, and here is where it is.

steps.title: The room
steps.position: Inside, a few steps from the bar, back to a wall
steps.direction: Turn slowly from the bar to the room in one smooth move, hips and phone together, then whip to the right. Keep it wide; no close-ups of other guests.

captions.script: Tonight is the night. The place is buzzing and we just got here.
Here is how busy it is, and the night has only started.
The room. Grab a stool at the bar if you are quick.

steps.title: Cheers
steps.position: At the table with your friends, phone low on the table edge
steps.direction: Start with a quick swing into the glasses, then hold the phone still just below the rims while your friends clink. Film only friends who are happy to be in it.

captions.script: Cheers to good friends and a good night.
Good drinks are better in good company.
Your next round is waiting. Pull up a seat.

steps.title: Join us
steps.position: At the bar, the taps behind you
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length with the bar behind you. Say the name, the happy hour or the price of a pint, and the neighborhood.
steps.prompter: We are staying a while. Here is the name and the drink prices.

captions.script: We are staying a while. Here is the name and the drink prices.
There is a stool at the bar with your name on it.
That is my new favorite spot. Maybe I will see you here next time.

templates.title: Tasting flight
templates.summary: A flight of beers or tasters: the row of glasses, the tap board, a rating, the winner and where to order it.

steps.title: The flight
steps.position: At the table, standing over the flight
steps.direction: Hold the phone just above the rims, tilted down, and slide it slowly along the row from the lightest glass to the darkest.

captions.script: Tasting flight time. Every glass gets a rating from me.
A few to try, one to order again. Let's see which one wins.
Let's taste. Starting light and working our way up.

steps.title: The tap board
steps.position: At the bar, a step back from the taps
steps.direction: Start on the tap board or the brewhouse tanks above the bar, then tilt down slowly to the row of tap handles.

captions.script: Here is everything on the board, and where it comes from.
The whole tap list is up here. Here is how the flight works.

steps.title: First glass
steps.position: Sitting at the table
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length, the first glass in hand. Take a small sip and rate it.
steps.prompter: Number one is the lightest. Crisp, a little bitter, easy to drink.

captions.script: Number one is the lightest. Crisp, a little bitter, easy to drink.
Here is my score for this one, and it is the lightest.

steps.title: The favorite
steps.position: Sitting at the table
steps.direction: Front camera close to your face. Name your winner, then raise the glass toward the lens until it fills the frame.
steps.prompter: This one is the winner. Not even close, I'm ordering a full glass.

captions.script: This one is the winner. Not even close, I'm ordering a full glass.
If you only try one thing here, make it this one.

steps.title: Come taste
steps.position: At the bar, phone close to your glass
steps.direction: Start with the lens almost touching your glass on the bar, tilted down, then lean back slowly so the bar and the taps come into view.

captions.script: Come taste the flight yourself and tell me your winner.
There is a stool at the bar with your name on it.
Ask for the flight at the bar, the price is on the board.

templates.title: Live music night
templates.summary: Walk in to the music, the band, a drink between sets, the event board, and which night to come.

steps.title: Walk in
steps.position: At the door, phone at chest height
steps.direction: Walk in slowly toward the stage with the phone at your chest, short steps, the music playing.

captions.script: Heard the band from the street, so we followed it inside.
Live music tonight, and we got here just before the first song.

steps.title: Our table
steps.position: At your table or a spot by the wall
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length with the stage lights behind you. Say what tonight is.
steps.prompter: Live band, a cold drink, and here is our table tonight.

captions.script: Live band, a cold drink, and here is our table tonight.
Here is our seat tonight, and this is the view of the stage.

steps.title: The band
steps.position: At your table or the side of the room
steps.direction: Hold the phone low and steady and move in slowly toward the stage, then whip to the right at the end. Film the band and the lights; keep other guests' faces out of close-up.

captions.script: Turn the sound on for this one. Listen to the room.
Here is who is playing tonight, straight from our table.
Here is the room once the band gets going.

steps.title: Between sets
steps.position: At the bar, standing over your glass
steps.direction: Start mid-swing, then hold the phone still above your glass on the bar while the bartender sets it down.

captions.script: First round between songs, made while the band played.
Grabbed a drink between sets, right at the bar.

steps.title: Who plays when
steps.position: Under the event board, by the door or the bar
steps.direction: Stand under the board with the dates or the band list and move in slowly to tonight's line.

captions.script: Here is the board with who plays when, so take a photo.
Next show is on the board. Pick a night and bring someone.

steps.title: Which night
steps.position: Outside the door or at your table
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length. Say which night to come, the cover charge and where it is.
steps.prompter: Here is which night to come, the cover, and where it is.

captions.script: Here is which night to come, the cover, and where it is.
Bring someone next time, this band is better with a crowd.

templates.title: Happy hour
templates.summary: What happy hour buys: the pour, the hours and prices on the board, one drink and one bite, the room, and when to come.

steps.title: The pour
steps.position: At the bar, elbows on the bar top
steps.direction: Hold the phone beside the glass while it is poured, then lean in slowly until the foam or the ice fills the frame.

captions.script: Happy hour is on, and the first pour is already up.
Right on time for happy hour. This is the first one.

steps.title: The hours
steps.position: In front of the happy hour board or menu
steps.direction: Start with the phone close on the happy hour times, low and tilted up, then lean back slowly until the prices show.

captions.script: Here are the hours, so you know when to get here.
Here are the happy hour prices, drinks and bites.

steps.title: The deal
steps.position: At the bar
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length, your drink in hand. Say what happy hour gets you.
steps.prompter: Happy hour is on right now. Here is what it gets you.

captions.script: Happy hour is on right now. Here is what it gets you.
One drink and one bite, that is the whole plan tonight.

steps.title: Drink and a bite
steps.position: Standing at the bar or your table
steps.direction: Stand and hold the phone straight above your drink and one bite from the happy hour menu, then reach in and pick up the glass.

captions.script: One drink and one bite from the happy hour menu, that is the order.
Here is the order: a happy hour drink and the snack that goes with it.

steps.title: The room
steps.position: Back to a wall, the room in front of you
steps.direction: Turn slowly from one side of the room to the other, hips and phone together. Keep it wide; no close-ups of other guests.

captions.script: Here is how busy it gets, so you know when to grab a seat.
Here is where to sit. Grab a seat before they go.

steps.title: When to come
steps.position: At the bar or outside the door
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length. Say the happy hour times, what you paid and the name.
steps.prompter: That is the drink, the bite, the hours, and the name.

captions.script: That is the drink, the bite, the hours, and the name.
Worth leaving work on time for. Here is where it is.

templates.title: First try
templates.summary: An activity venue on a first visit: POV of the main attraction, the reaction, how big the place is, the ticket and the price.

steps.title: The ride
steps.position: On the ride, the slide or the course, phone in a strap or pouch
steps.direction: Only where phones are allowed: hold the phone at your chest in a strap or a waterproof pouch and film straight ahead as the ride or the run starts.

captions.script: First time on this, and here is the very first second.
Here we go. No turning back once you start.
We went straight for the biggest one here.

steps.title: Reaction
steps.position: Right after the ride, at the exit
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length straight after the run, still out of breath or soaked. Say how it was.
steps.prompter: First time trying this, and I was not ready for that.

captions.script: First time trying this, and I was not ready for that.
Straight off the ride and already asking to go again.

steps.title: The whole place
steps.position: Somewhere high: a platform, the top of the stairs, a viewing deck
steps.direction: From up high, turn slowly across the whole park or arena to show how big it is, then whip the phone to the right at the end.

captions.script: This is the whole place. Here is how big it is.
Here is everything you can do here, all in one place.

steps.title: The ticket
steps.position: At the entrance or the ticket desk
steps.direction: Start mid-swing, then hold the phone level with your wristband, ticket or the price board and move in slowly to the price.

captions.script: Here is what the ticket costs and what it covers.
Price check: this is what one person pays at the door.

steps.title: Worth it
steps.position: Outside, the entrance behind you
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length with the entrance behind you. Say the ticket price, how long you stayed and where it is.
steps.prompter: Here is the ticket price, how long we stayed, and where.

captions.script: Here is the ticket price, how long we stayed, and where.
Tag the friend who would scream the loudest on this.

templates.title: Group challenge
templates.summary: A group of friends takes on the game: the bet, POV in the action, the reaction, the scoreboard and the price per player.

steps.title: The bet
steps.position: At the start line or the arena entrance, your group behind you
steps.direction: Front camera held up a little higher than your face so the whole group fits. Film only friends who agreed to be in it.
steps.prompter: All of us, one round, and the loser buys the snacks.

captions.script: All of us, one round, and the loser buys the snacks.
All of us, one game, and nobody is going easy.

steps.title: In the game
steps.position: In the game: the arena, the lane, the track or the course
steps.direction: Where phones are allowed, hold the phone at your chest and turn slowly with the action, then whip to the left at the end.

captions.script: Game on. Seconds in and it is already chaos.
Nobody is safe in here, not even the person filming.

steps.title: The reaction
steps.position: Facing your group after the round
steps.direction: Start mid-swing, then hold the phone still at eye level on your friends as they react to the round.

captions.script: That was the moment we found out who was really winning.
Somebody is already asking for a rematch, and it is not me.

steps.title: The score
steps.position: Under the scoreboard or holding the score card
steps.direction: Start with the phone close on the winner's name or score, then lean back slowly until every name shows.

captions.script: And the winner is right here. Look at the score.
Final score. Somebody owes the whole group snacks now.

steps.title: Tag your team
steps.position: Outside or in the lobby, your group around you
steps.direction: Front camera at arm's length with the group around you. Say who won, the price per player and where to book.
steps.prompter: Here is who won, the price per player, and where to book.

captions.script: Here is who won, the price per player, and where to book.
Tag the friends you would bring, and pick your teams now.

pour.reads: The glass fills and the head settles while nothing else moves; match-cut on the glass as the creator lifts it into the selfie.

hook.reads: Face and glass held still at arm's length; cut to the back camera on the room.

crowd.reads: The room slides past from the bar to the tables, then a whip to the right lands on the glasses at the table.

cheers.reads: From below the rims the glasses meet in the middle of the frame; cut to the front camera for the invite.

outro.reads: Arm's length, face and bar in frame, held still while the name and the price land.

flight.reads: The glasses slide past from light to dark, the front rims faster than the back; cut low to the tap board.

taps.reads: The board slides up out of frame and the tap handles come into view below it; cut to the front camera at the table.

first.reads: Face and glass at arm's length, still while the first rating lands; cut closer for the winner.

favorite.reads: The face close to the lens, then the glass rises until it fills the frame; the next shot opens on the same glass on the bar.

outro.reads: From the glass filling the frame, the bar and its taps open up around it; held still for the end card.

walkin.reads: The door opens onto the room and the stage grows as we walk in; cut to the front camera.

hook.reads: Face at arm's length with the stage lights behind, held still; cut to the back camera on the band.

stage.reads: The stage rises over the room and the band grows as we ease in; a whip right lands on the bar.

drink.reads: From above, a glass lands on the bar and settles under the lights; cut low to the event board.

board.reads: The board grows from below until tonight's line fills the frame; cut to the front camera for the verdict.

verdict.reads: Arm's length, face and door or stage behind, held still while the night and the cover land.

pour.reads: The glass fills and the camera eases in until the foam fills the frame; the next shot opens filled by the board.

board.reads: The hours fill the frame, then the camera eases back until the prices sit under them; cut to the front camera.

hook.reads: Face and glass at arm's length, held still for the deal; cut to the back camera straight above the bar.

bite.reads: From straight above, a glass and a small plate sit on the bar and a hand reaches in for the glass; cut to eye level on the room.

room.reads: The room turns past from the bar to the booths; cut to the front camera for the verdict.

verdict.reads: Arm's length, face and bar in frame, held still while the hours and the name land.

ride.reads: The drop, the line or the arena door rushes toward us as we move forward; cut to the front camera after the run.

hook.reads: Face at arm's length, out of breath, held still for the line; cut to the back camera up high.

park.reads: The whole park turns past from above, attractions side by side; a whip right lands on the ticket.

ticket.reads: The wristband or the price board settles and grows until the price fills the frame; cut to the front camera for the verdict.

verdict.reads: Arm's length, face and entrance in frame, held still while the price and the name land.

hook.reads: The group squeezes into the frame from slightly above, held still for the bet; cut to the back camera in the game.

action.reads: The game moves across the frame as we turn with it; a whip left lands on the group's reaction.

reaction.reads: The group mid-laugh or mid-argument, held still; cut low and tight to the scoreboard.

score.reads: One name fills the frame, then the board opens up to show every score; cut to the front camera.

verdict.reads: Arm's length, the group in frame, held still while the price and the name land.
